camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo CreateWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --Act close --Mode prefix --Count 60 --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Ttl 60 --Uri '/abc/a.php' --Name testrule --Interval 20
description_en: Creates a custom rule for website HTTP flood protection (CC protection)
description_zh: 创建网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo create-web-cc-rule --domain www.aliyun.com --name testrule --act close --count 60 --interval 20 --biz-mode prefix --ttl 60 --uri /abc/a.php --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWebCCRule

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS instance in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The rule name. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_) and cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。支持使用英文字母、数字或下划线（_），且长度不能超过128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The action to be performed on requests that match the rule. Valid values:

close: blocks the request.
captcha: initiates bot detection
parameters.help_zh:
对命中防护规则的请求执行的动作。取值：

close：表示封禁该请求。
captcha：表示发起人机识别验证
parameters.name: act

parameters.help_en: The number of access requests from a single IP address. Valid values: 2 to 2000
parameters.help_zh: 单一IP访问次数。取值范围：2~2000
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: The detection duration. Valid values: 5 to 10800. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 检测时长。取值范围：5~10800，单位：秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode. Valid values:

prefix: prefix match.
match: exact match.

If the detection path URI contains parameters, select prefix match (prefix)
parameters.help_zh:
匹配模式。取值：
prefix：表示前缀匹配。
match：表示完全匹配。

检测路径URI中包含参数时，请选择前缀匹配（prefix）
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The blocking duration. Valid values: 60 to 86400. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 封禁时长。取值范围：60~86400，单位：秒
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The detection path.

The URI cannot be modified. A rule is uniquely identified by the domain name of the website, the detection path, and the rule name
parameters.help_zh:
检测路径。
URI不支持修改。网站业务的域名，检测路径，规则名称唯一确定一条规则
parameters.name: uri

schema.description_en: The body of the returned data
